messages:
Iris (PM): moving forward with a small-batch DP pilot focused on launch-readiness signals. proposal: 2-week intake, onboard 4 partners in parallel, 6-week observation window. Incentives: $2k credits + 6hrs eng support. ok with team?
Noah - Product Ops: sounds good. will need a clear selection rubric so we don't onboard unsuitable partners. propose criteria: committed integration owner, <2 week expected setup, no live PII in test traffic, strategic alignment to roadmap use-cases.
Samira (CS): +1. add 'willing to run weekly 15m check-in' to rubric. that'll keep feedback loop tight and reduce surprises.
Liam Eng: engineering notes: need a DP toggle in console for feature-flagged routing, telemetry tags, and ephemeral API keys. estimate 2 dev-days for minimal toggle + logging.
Iris (PM): onboarding template: 1) intake form 2) pre-screen call 30m 3) sandbox api key + sample run 4) weekly check-ins + short survey. Priya, any legal constraints for lightweight participation agreement?
Priya Legal: prefer a one-page addendum for pilot partners: data handling, retention (30d), ephemeral keys, right-to-publish case study with opt-out. avoids full NDA friction.
devrel-bot: created draft intake: https://forms.redwood.com/dp-batch-pilot (fields: company, contact, use-case, expected volume, production-intent, case-study opt-in).
Noah - Product Ops: success metrics suggestion: time-to-activation (hrs), activation rate within 10 days, p95 latency delta vs baseline, and partner NPS at week 4. also track eng hours spent.
Samira (CS): add 'integration blocker count' and qualitative severity (showstopper/minor). helps decide escalation.
Liam Eng: for rollback safety we should require a hosted fallback route and set automatic thresholds: error rate >4% for 10min or p99 latency >2s above baseline -> auto-route to fallback. also provide manual abort in console.
Iris (PM): good. timeline: publish invite to targeted accounts next Wed, intake open for 10 business days, select 4 partners, onboard within 3 weeks. Staffing: CS to handle check-ins, Eng to do 6hrs/partner onboarding support.
Samira (CS): i can cover weekly calls. will prepare a 3-question weekly survey (ease of integration, quality, blockers).
Priya Legal: i'll circulate addendum template today. keep it simple to speed sign-ups.
Noah - Product Ops: we'll surface a small dashboard: onboarding hours, activation time, error rate, latency delta, weekly survey score.
Iris (PM): edge cases: if partner needs to use sensitive data, move to full legal review and dedicated pilot contract. otherwise keep it lightweight.
Liam Eng: one more: require partners to provide an anonymized dataset or clearly scoped synthetic tests. we'll refuse live data for the pilot.
Iris (PM): agreed. next steps: devrel to message invite copy, legal to share addendum, ops to publish form + dashboard, eng to scope console flag. sync Fri to confirm readiness. thanks! :rocket:
